metadata.short_desc: Keyword auto-reply plugin driven by a fixed Q&A table
metadata.desc: A keyword auto-reply plugin driven by a fixed Q&A table: a local regex first recalls a matching question, and only on a hit does TypeSafe AI's SystemOne judge whether the message is a real question before the canned answer is sent.

systemone-console.title: SystemOne Console
systemone-console.desc: Edit decision and reply policies, inspect runtime status, and try message intent live.
